request.query: Lower bound min(l theta/2, r theta^2/3) for sum over natural nu<l of max(0, theta-nu/r)

items.name: AkraBazziRecurrence.eventually_atTop_sumTransform_ge
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] {T : ℕ → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : α → ℝ} {r : α → ℕ → ℕ} [inst_1 : Nonempty α]
  (R : AkraBazziRecurrence T g a b r),
  ∃ c > 0,
    ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
      ∀ (i : α), c * g ↑n ≤ AkraBazziRecurrence.sumTransform (AkraBazziRecurrence.p a b) g (r i n) n

items.name: Finset.le_sum_schlomilch
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M] {f : ℕ → M} {u : ℕ → ℕ},
  (∀ ⦃m n : ℕ⦄, 0 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < u n) →
      Monotone u →
        ∀ (n : ℕ),
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (u n), f k ≤
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (u 0), f k + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (u (k + 1) - u k) • f (u k)

items.name: le_hasSum_of_le_sum
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_3} {L : SummationFilter ι} [inst : Preorder α] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid α]
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace α] {a c : α} {f : ι → α} [ClosedIciTopology α] [L.NeBot],
  HasSum f a L → (∀ (s : Finset ι), c ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, f i) → c ≤ a

items.name: Chebyshev.psi_eq_theta_add_sum_theta
items.type:
∀ {x : ℝ},
  2 ≤ x →
    Chebyshev.psi x = Chebyshev.theta x + ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 ⌊Real.log x / Real.log 2⌋₊, Chebyshev.theta (x ^ (1 / ↑n))

items.name: ENNReal.le_iInf_add_iInf
items.type:
∀ {ι : Sort u_1} {f : ι → ENNReal} {a : ENNReal} {κ : Sort u_2} {g : κ → ENNReal},
  (∀ (i : ι) (j : κ), a ≤ f i + g j) → a ≤ iInf f + iInf g

items.name: Chebyshev.theta_le_log4_mul_x
items.type: ∀ {x : ℝ}, 0 ≤ x → Chebyshev.theta x ≤ Real.log 4 * x
